archetypes.name: Armoured Spearhead
archetypes.desc:
- Must select a Legacy: the Legion of that Legacy is the Legion of the whole army and all its units and characters belong to it.
- Legion Predators can be taken as Troops.
- Legion Sicaran Battle Tanks can be taken as Elites.
- A unit that could take a Legion Rhino may take a Land Raider Carrier instead if it has ten models or fewer.

archetypes.name: Brethren of Iron
archetypes.desc:
- Must select a Legacy: the Legion of that Legacy is the Legion of the whole army and all its units and characters belong to it.
- The army has access to all Robot units from the Horus Heresy Mechanicum supplement.
- Castellax Battle-automata Maniple units may be taken as Troops.
- Only Robot units count towards the 25% Troops limitation.

archetypes.name: Death from Above
archetypes.desc:
- Must select a Legacy: the Legion of that Legacy is the Legion of the whole army and all its units and characters belong to it.
- Legion Assault Squad units may be taken as Troops.
- Only Legion Assault Squad units count towards the 25% Troops limitation.
- At least half of all Legion Assault Squad models must start the game in reserves, even if the mission does not allow reserves.

archetypes.name: Drop Pod Assault (HH)
archetypes.desc:
- Must select a Legacy: the Legion of that Legacy is the Legion of the whole army and all its units and characters belong to it.
- All units must start the game as passengers inside a Legion Drop Pod.
- Half of all Legion Drop Pods in the army (round up) arrive automatically in the first battle round as reinforcements. The other half arrive automatically in the second battle round.

archetypes.name: Legion Specialists
archetypes.desc:
- Must select a Legacy: the Legion of that Legacy is the Legion of the whole army and all its units and characters belong to it.
- The army may take 1-3 HQ and 0-4 Elite units in the first AOP.
- Techmarines and Apothecaries cannot be promoted to a Forge Lord or a Primus Medicae.

archetypes.name: Outrider Phalanx
archetypes.desc:
- Must select a Legacy: the Legion of that Legacy is the Legion of the whole army and all its units and characters belong to it.
- Outrider Squadron and Legion Sky-hunter Squadron units may be taken as Troops.
- Outflanking units may be deployed on turn 1.
- All units with less than 12" Movement must start the game as passengers inside a transport.
- Units that have no transport option and less than 12" Movement cannot be taken at all.

archetypes.name: Pride of the Legion
archetypes.desc:
- Must select a Legacy: the Legion of that Legacy is the Legion of the whole army and all its units and characters belong to it.
- Legion Veteran Squad, Legion Terminator Cataphractii Squad, Legion Tartaros Terminator Squad units may be taken as Troops.
- Any unit composed entirely of models with either Cataphractii Terminator armor, Tartaros Terminator armor or any other pattern of Terminator armor and that is normally selected as an Elites choice may be taken as Troops.
- Only Veteran and Terminator units count towards the 25% Troops limitation.
- Only a single Heavy Support choice and a single Fast Attack choice may be taken in this army.

archetypes.name: Recon Demi-Company
archetypes.desc:
- Must select a Legacy: the Legion of that Legacy is the Legion of the whole army and all its units and characters belong to it.
- Legion Scout Squads and Seeker Squads can be taken as Troops.

archetypes.name: Underworld Assault
archetypes.desc:
- Must select a Legacy: the Legion of that Legacy is the Legion of the whole army and all its units and characters belong to it.
- All units must start the game as passengers inside a Legion Termite.
- Half of all Legion Termites in the army (round up) arrive automatically in the first battle round as reinforcements. The other half arrive automatically in the second battle round.

archetypes.name: Dark Angels
archetypes.desc:
- Must select "Legacy of the Lion".
- Any model may give its Power swords the "Rending(6+)" ability for +1 point each.
- Any model may exchange their Plasma guns for Plasma repeaters for +12 points each.
- Any model may exchange their Missile launchers for Stasis missile launchers for +4 points each.
- The army gets access to all units from this book that can take the Dark Angels Legion and all units must take it.
- The army can only take a second trait if the first one is "Grim Resolve" or "Scions of the Hexagrammaton". All traits combined cost 10 points for each non-character unit.

archetypes.name: White Scars
archetypes.desc:
- Must select "Legacy of the Great Khan".
- The army gets access to all units from this book that can take the White Scars Legion and all units must take it.
- The army can only take a second trait if the first one is "Swift Action" or "Eye of the Storm". All traits combined cost 10 points for each non-character unit.

archetypes.name: Space Wolves
archetypes.desc:
- Must select "Legacy of the Wolf King".
- The army gets access to all units from this book that can take the Space Wolves Legion and all units must take it.
- The army can only take a second trait if the first one is "Bestial Savagery" or "Unleashed Hunters". All traits combined cost 10 points for each non-character unit.

archetypes.name: Imperial Fists
archetypes.desc:
- Must select "Legacy of the Praetorian of Terra".
- The army gets access to all units from this book that can take the Imperial Fists Legion and all units must take it.
- The army can only take a second trait if the first one is "Bolter Drill" or "Unshakable Defence". All traits combined cost 10 points for each non-character unit.

archetypes.name: Blood Angels
archetypes.desc:
- Must select "Legacy of the Angel".
- The army gets access to all units from this book that can take the Blood Angels Legion and all units must take it.
- The army can only take a second trait if the first one is "Encarmine Fury" or "Without Remorse, Without Relent". All traits combined cost 10 points for each non-character unit.

archetypes.name: Iron Hands
archetypes.desc:
- Must select "Legacy of the Gorgon".
- Any model may exchange their Plasma pistols for Graviton pistols for +1 point each and Graviton guns for Graviton shredders for +1 point each.
- The army gets access to all units from this book that can take the Iron Hands Legion and all units must take it.
- The army can only take a second trait if the first one is "The Medusa's Scales" or "Inviolate Armor". All traits combined cost 10 points for each non-character unit.

archetypes.name: Ultramarines
archetypes.desc:
- Must select "Legacy of the Avenging Son".
- The army gets access to all units from this book that can take the Ultramarines Legion and all units must take it.
- The army can only take a second trait if the first one is "Interlocking Tactics" or "Certainty and Resolve". All traits combined cost 10 points for each non-character unit.

archetypes.name: Salamanders
archetypes.desc:
- Must select "Legacy of the Lord of Drakes".
- The army gets access to all units from this book that can take the Salamanders Legion and all units must take it.
- The army can only take a second trait if the first one is "Promethean Blood" or "Strength of Will". All traits combined cost 10 points for each non-character unit.

archetypes.name: Raven Guard
archetypes.desc:
- Must select "Legacy of the Liberator".
- Any model may give its Lightning claws the "Rending(5+)" ability for +5 points each.
- The army gets access to all units from this book that can take the Raven Guard Legion and all units must take it.
- The army can only take a second trait if the first one is "By Wing and Talon" or "Shadow and Fury". All traits combined cost 10 points for each non-character unit.

archetypes.name: Shattered Legions
archetypes.desc:
- The army has two Legacies (any two Legions of this book), both chosen in Army Customisation, and each unit and character chooses which of the two it belongs to.
- A unit has everything of the Legacy it belongs to: its Legion benefits, its Armory, the special units, the Troops and the options of that Legion.
- The two Legacies must be of Legions that are not marked red against each other in the Legion alliances tab.
- Survivors of several betrayed Legions fighting under one banner: a unit is of one Legion or of the other, never of a third.
- The army has access to a third Trait, to choose from the list: three Legion Traits instead of two.

legacies.name: Legacy of the Lion
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Dark Angels Armory.
- The units of the army may receive the benefits of the Dark Angels Legion (see the Special rules in the Index).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Great Khan
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the White Scars Armory and the Stormcalling psychic discipline.
- The units of the army may receive the benefits of the White Scars Legion (see the Special rules in the Index).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Wolf King
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Space Wolves Armory and the Runecasting psychic discipline.
- The units of the army may receive the benefits of the Space Wolves Legion (see the Special rules in the Index).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Praetorian of Terra
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Imperial Fists Armory.
- The units of the army may receive the benefits of the Imperial Fists Legion (see the Special rules in the Index).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Angel
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Blood Angels Armory.
- The units of the army may receive the benefits of the Blood Angels Legion (see the Special rules in the Index).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Gorgon
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Iron Hands Armory.
- The units of the army may receive the benefits of the Iron Hands Legion (see the Special rules in the Index).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Avenging Son
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Ultramarines Armory.
- The units of the army may receive the benefits of the Ultramarines Legion (see the Special rules in the Index).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Lord of Drakes
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Salamanders Armory and the Fury of the Salamander psychic discipline.
- The units of the army may receive the benefits of the Salamanders Legion (see the Special rules in the Index).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Liberator
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Raven Guard Armory.
- The units of the army may receive the benefits of the Raven Guard Legion (see the Special rules in the Index).

traits.name: Grim Resolve
traits.desc: The unit does not suffer the to hit penalty from Defensive Fire.

traits.name: Scions of the Hexagrammaton
traits.desc: The unit's melee attacks with swords re-roll to hit rolls of 1.

traits.name: Swift Action
traits.desc: The unit may fire weapons with an Advance or Charge order, it may fire them without a to hit penalty.

traits.name: Unleashed Hunters
traits.desc: If the unit uses a Charge order or gets charged by an enemy unit, it gains +1 to melee hit rolls until the end of the current battle round. Only for creature models and Walkers.

traits.name: Bolter Drill
traits.desc: The unit gains the "Deflagrate(5+)" ability with Bolt weapons. Legion Tactical Squads gain "Deflagrate(4+)" with Bolt weapons.

traits.name: Unshakable Defence
traits.desc: The unit gains +1 Leadership and cannot be Pinned while it is in cover.

traits.name: Encarmine Fury
traits.desc: If the unit uses a Charge order or gets charged by an enemy unit, it gains +1 Strength until the end of the current battle round. Only for creature models and Walkers.

traits.name: Without Remorse, Without Relent
traits.desc: The unit gains the "Frenzy(1")" ability. Only for creature models and Walkers.

traits.name: The Medusa's Scales
traits.desc: The unit reduces the strength of all shooting attacks against it by -1. Only for creature models.

traits.name: Inviolate Armor
traits.desc: The unit may reroll one armor save per battle round. Only for creature models. Additionally, vehicles repair either one Engine Damage or Weapon Damage on themselves during each Rally phase.

traits.name: Interlocking Tactics
traits.desc: Whenever the unit makes a shooting attack against a target which has already been successfully hit in the same Shooting phase by another Ultramarines unit, it may re-roll To Wound and Armor Penetration rolls of 1.

traits.name: Certainty and Resolve
traits.desc: The unit is immune to the effects of the "Terrifying" ability, and a pinned or fleeing unit automatically regroups at the start of the turn or when it reaches the edge of the board.

traits.name: Promethean Blood
traits.desc: The unit reduces the strength of all Flamer, Melta, Plasma and Volkite ranged attacks against it by -1. Additionally, vehicles repair either one Engine Damage or Weapon Damage on themselves during each Rally phase.

traits.name: Strength of Will
traits.desc: The unit ignores negative leadership modifiers. Only for creature units.

traits.name: By Wing and Talon
traits.desc: Infantry units which do not have the "Unyielding" ability gain the "Infiltrator" ability, while Jump Pack Infantry, Bike, Jet Bike and Walker units gain the "Furious Charge" ability.

traits.name: Shadow and Fury
traits.desc: The unit gains the "Deflect" ability against ranged attacks from enemy units which are more than 12" away.
